decisions.reason: The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws on the firm's material and craftsmanship knowledge, so it can interpret premium-segment feedback and refine the product, which justifies keeping it in the range.

Two similar low-pile carpets have already been pruned, which signals overlap risk, but this one is still presented on its own page and builds on established designer collaborations, so it stays for now.
The corner bench extends core furniture competence that the firm can customize for residential and hospitality projects, giving strong capacity to learn from results and improve it.
The swivel shell chair line rests on deep seating know-how and serves both workplace and residential markets, so the firm can assimilate feedback across its several models.
